authority: Normative product capture and receiving-semantics contract. Binding support is separate from live controller availability and runtime acceptance.

policies.native_zone_phase_authority: Native valid selected zone entry/exit publication, independent of UI queue insertion or presentation acknowledgement; preserve original native callbacks and deduplicate selector/presentation observations.
policies.expired_zone_queue_reconciliation: Retire only tracked zone identities after real native exit/removal, on the main looper, while API-managed and without started source Activities or a live source car service. Recheck that the current native model is absent or LeftZone before removing its local queue ID. Temporary invalidity/silence is not retirement authority. Never invoke native presentation/start/timeout acknowledgements.
policies.uuidless_native_sound_identity: Preserve full provider/unique/UUID event identity. A native sound request omitting UUID may correlate only a unique current provider+unique match, or its synchronous captured zone controller; reject ambiguity and conflicting explicit UUIDs.
policies.native_measurement_clocks: A new native sound/zone decision creates fresh announcement authority, not a fresh distance, trigger, position or validation measurement. Preserve the latest real repository observation clock for cached descriptor fields, including decisions after display-state expiry.
